purpose covered: Purpose (two Desktop scripts that mount/unmount the user's CIFS shares under /tmp with the user's credentials) matches the header comment and manifest/templates. The checks test it end to end on gnome against a real Samba share on ubuntu2: scripts present root:root 0755 in ~/Desktop (now created by a real first GDM login, fixture p8test_desktop_login, which only declares p8testuser and triggers that login, test asset) and rendered with share/CIFS version/$USER/explorer off; run as p8testuser with the right password the share mounts as cifs, private to the user (nobody denied) with the server file readable; a wrong password exits 1 with the template's error message and mounts nothing; the unmount script unmounts it. Cache/delay defaults are exercised implicitly (no cache=none, sleep 0.5). Honestly uncovered: the kdialog password prompt (needs input to a desktop session), explorer=True (dolphin, the default, exists only on kubuntu while phase3.py runs a set on its plan node gnome only) and the symlinks/cache=False/delay variants (one params fixture per set); evidence states the fixture's explorer False/$PASSWORD choice and the runner's single-fixture, single-node limits, lifted by a named capability.
